scope: Independent source inspection and three fresh CPU regression runs. Physical operator/core results belong to numerical_runtime and are bound, not rerun by this reviewer. No exhaustive mathematical or whole-model qualification claim.

math.product: 24-bit integer significand multiplication reconstructs the product residual without a reassociable floating multiply/subtract identity. Reconstruction preserves nearest-even subnormal output bits. Prior generic product reviews remain separate evidence.
math.addition: Bitwise equality fast paths retain a tiny addend when the rounded sum equals its peer. Signed aligned significands recover the residual of the actual supplied sum. Correction additions that flush to zero recover the integer residual; pair normalization promotes that residual into the high component.
math.pair: pair_mul_scalar retains high and low multiplication residuals, combines through pair_add, and normalizes. pair_add separately recovers high-addition, low-addition and joined-tail residuals.

resolvedWitness.input: pair_add((0, minimum positive F32 subnormal), (0, 0)) under a backend that flushes floating subnormal operations
resolvedWitness.priorFailure: Plain low/tail addition lost the carried component.
resolvedWitness.repair: add_preserving_underflow and pair_normalize integer recovery; physical min-subnormal carry controls retained.

contractLimit.intermediate: The initial high-component sum overflows to Infinity.
contractLimit.disposition: Explicitly outside finite-intermediate contract; nonfinite propagation retained, not an extended-exponent or all-finite-input guarantee.

math.materialization: Both state components persist through decay and update. State contraction/delta/output accumulation also use pairs; activation output subsequently materializes into the existing scalar F32 boundary. This is more than merely duplicating storage and is not exact F64 execution.

state.components: Explicit f32=1 / two-f32=2; invalid precision rejected. Default f32 unchanged.
state.allocation: Scalar geometry and required byte count validated as positive safe integers at the direct GPU kernel boundary. Buffer must cover geometry × components × 4.
state.identity: Pipeline cache key includes input dtype and state component count; recurrent and fused pipelines receive the same override.
state.ownership: Clone reads/copies full two-component state and metadata. Restore validates schema and every layer layout before releasing active target buffers. Old schema requires reset; active attempt precision changes reject. Reset releases old buffers and clears layers.
state.indexing: Logical per-layer/head/k/v index is multiplied by component count only in state_load/state_store for two-component paths. The f32 branch retains original one-component direct indexing.
state.probes: Existing probe reads full recurrentState.length as F32 words. Raw two-component probes are interleaved storage, not a pre-summed logical tensor; downstream diagnostic decoding must bind declared layout.

disposition: No additional arithmetic or state-ownership blocker established within the stated finite-intermediate domain. Diagnostic interleaved-state interpretation requires explicit layout. Mac whole-model receipt fails 17/55 prefixes: operator correctness and user approval do not qualify the model or archive. No pin change, deployment, GPU run, or runtime edit performed by this review.
